name: Sotsugyou Shashin 2 ~Raspberry Dream~
source:
Yosuke Katsuragi is a 3rd grade high school student. During the summer vacation he walks around the city without particular reason and encounters various girls. Who will be smiling beside him on the photo stand the day the summer vacation ends and the day of the graduation ceremony?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-november-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
桂木陽介是一名高三學生。暑假期間，他漫無目的地在城市裡閒逛，與形形色色的女孩相遇。暑假結束之日與畢業典禮當天，相框裡，微笑著陪在他身旁的會是誰？

[譯自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-november-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
